content.text: ActualitésHarry Potter Trailer Shatters HBO and HBO Max RecordsHBO announced today that the Harry Potter trailer delivered +277 million organic (non-paid) views across platforms in its first 48 hours, becoming the most-watched trailer in HBO and HBO Max history and exceeding the previous record by more than double.The first season of the series, titled Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone, will debut Christmas 2026 on HBO and will be available to stream exclusively on HBO Max.There is nothing special about Harry Potter – at least that’s what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship, and magic.Voir l'article complet sur Vital Thrills27/03/2026par Mirko ParlevlietVital ThrillsHBO's 'Harry Potter' Series Has Already Broken a 'Game of Thrones' RecordHBO’s new Harry Potter series was always going to be one of the most heavily watched TV launches in recent memory. Even before a single frame had been released, the show was already carrying the weight of one of the biggest franchises in modern entertainment, along with all the curiosity, skepticism, and hype that comes with that. Fans wanted to know what Hogwarts would look like, how the new cast would feel, and whether this fresh version could actually stand on its own. Now that the first trailer is out, the early answer seems pretty clear: people were absolutely ready to return to the Wizarding World.HBO has announced...Voir l'article complet sur Collider.com27/03/2026par Chris McPhersonCollider.comHarry Potter Trailer Divides Fans As They Compare HBO Series To MoviesThe first trailer for HBO's Harry Potter series has been released, and it is already dividing fans.The Harry Potter season 1 teaser trailer provides the best look yet at Dominic McLaughlin as the titular hero, Alastair Stout as Ron Weasley, Arabella Stanton as Hermione Granger, and other key characters at Hogwarts, on the Hogwarts Express, and at the Dursleys' home. The trailer also confirmed that the series will debut during Christmas 2026, which is earlier than the previously expected release window of early 2027.On X, fans are reacting to the trailer and inevitably comparing it to the beloved movies starring Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, and Emma Watson. Framesofnick laments how the...Voir l'article complet sur ScreenRant25/03/2026par Matthew RudoyScreenRantHarry Potter Is Officially Returning This YearWe're being given a magical Christmas present by HBO Max this year, following the release of the truly enchanting first trailer for their upcoming Harry Potter series, which will be adapting The Philosopher's Stone. Despite widely stating that the series would not hit our screens until next year, those sneaky little beaters have whacked a bludger in our festive plans.Yes, the Harry Potter series will now debut at Christmas rather than in the New Year. The new Harry Potter series stars Dominic McLaughlin as Harry Potter, Arabella Stanton as Hermione Granger, and Alastair Stout as Ron Weasley, alongside John Lithgow as Albus Dumbledore, Paapa Essiedu as Severus Snape, Janet McTeer as Minerva McGonagall,...Voir l'article complet sur Collider.com25/03/2026par Chris McPhersonCollider.comHarry Potter’s Most Iconic Locations Revealed in New Set Video from HBO’s SeriesFor a franchise this beloved, there are a few locations fans will always obsess over first. Hogwarts is obviously one of them, but Diagon Alley is right up there too — the place where the Wizarding World first truly opens up and suddenly gets bigger, stranger, and a lot more magical.Now, it looks like HBO’s new Harry Potter series may have just offered its clearest glimpse yet at how it plans to reimagine that world.According to a newly shared report and video from a British tabloid, the upcoming series’ version of Diagon Alley appears to have been spotted on set, revealing a street that looks both familiar and...Voir l'article complet sur Collider.com09/03/2026par Chris McPhersonCollider.comHarry Potter TV Series Adds 21 Hogwarts Students, Including Katie Bell, Padma Patil, And Pansy ParkinsonWith work underway on HBO's Harry Potter TV series, 21 new actors have just been added to the already massive ensemble. As we first reported on SFFGazette.com, each Hogwarts house is being fleshed out with well-known and relatively obscure students from J.K. Rowling's novels.For Gryffindor, we have Eire Farrell as Katie Bell, Asha Soetan as Angelina Johnson, Orson Matthews as Oliver Wood, Serrana Su-Ling Bliss as Alicia Spinnet, and Ethan Smith as Lee Jordan.Over to Hufflepuff, and there's India Moon as Hannah Abbott, Jazmyn Lewin as Susan Bones, Cian Eagle-Service as Ernie Macmillan, and James Trevelyan Buckle as Justin Finch-Fletchley.Ravenclaw has also added to its ranks...Voir l'article complet sur ComicBookMovie.com06/03/2026ComicBookMovie.comHBO's Harry Potter TV Series Has Cast A Second Ron Weasley For Season 1As work continues on HBO's Harry Potter TV series, we've learned that three minor additions have been made to the cast. At least two of them give us a much better idea of what to expect from the cable network's small-screen adaptation.According to Redanian Intelligence (via SFFGazette.com), Naomi Wirthner will play Madam Malkin. As the name suggests, the witch owns Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions in Diagon Alley. Her presence in the series seemingly confirms that Harry will have his first meeting with Draco Malfoy there while shopping for his Hogwarts uniform alongside Hagrid.That lines up with J.K. Rowling's novels, but differs from the movies,...Voir l'article complet sur ComicBookMovie.com20/02/2026ComicBookMovie.comHarry Potter Actor Warns HBO Series Will Look Very Different From the BooksHBO Max’s upcoming Harry Potter reboot has been described as a “faithful adaptation” of the books — but according to one of its new stars, that doesn’t mean a page-by-page retread. In fact, it sounds like the opposite.Enter Lox Pratt, the 14-year-old actor set to play Draco Malfoy in the new series, which is scheduled to premiere in early 2027. Pratt, who will appear across what’s expected to be a seven-season run (one season per book), has confirmed that the show will significantly expand beyond the books’ limited perspective — and that’s going to reshape how fans experience the story.In the novels (and films), everything is filtered through Harry’s eyes.Voir l'article complet sur Collider.com08/02/2026par Chris McPhersonCollider.comHarry Potter Set Photos Reveal First Look At Hogwarts Mascots, Herbology Greenhouse, And MoreHBO's Harry Potter TV series launches with its first season, based on The Philosopher's Stone, next year. The show is expected to be in production for the better part of a decade, and various parts of the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry have been constructed in the UK.Photos shared on social media (via SFFGazette.com) reveal part of the iconic Whomping Willow, as well as the beautiful Herbology Greenhouse. We also see the castle grounds with the Hogwarts mascots, and each is depicted in the form of a (living?) hedge.It's incredible seeing how these small corners of the Wizarding World have been built from scratch, and it's...Voir l'article complet sur ComicBookMovie.com08/02/2026ComicBookMovie.comHogwarts Is Being Reimagined for HBO Max’s ‘Harry Potter’The wizarding world isn’t just coming back — it’s being rebuilt from the ground up. New set images from HBO Max’s upcoming Harry Potter series reveal that Hogwarts is getting a full-scale reimagining, and fans are already dissecting every brick, branch, and greenhouse in sight.Filming is currently underway in the UK for the long-gestating TV adaptation, which is slated to debut in 2027, and the latest photos give us our clearest look yet at how expansive this version of Hogwarts is shaping up to be. Visible constructions include the Hogwarts courtyard, what appears to be Professor Sprout’s greenhouse, and the unmistakable outline of the Whomping Willow — a...Voir l'article complet sur Collider.com06/02/2026par Chris McPhersonCollider.comHBO Confirms ‘Harry Potter’ Series is Still Releasing in Early 2027The highly anticipated upcoming HBO TV adaptation of Jk Rowling‘s Harry Potter books is on many people’s watchlist, and they’re wondering when the series will finally come out, since they only know it is supposed to come out sometime in 2027.Now, HBO’s Chairman, Casey Bloys, has confirmed that the upcoming Harry Potter series will debut on HBO in early 2027. During an interview with Deadline, Bloys said, “we’ve been saying 2027, I would say, to narrow it down to some extent, early 2027. And now you’re going to ask, does that mean January, February, March, April, that we’re not ready to say. I’ll say early...Voir l'article complet sur Cinema Blind31/01/2026par Kulwant SinghCinema BlindHarry Potter Series Gets Premiere Window On HBOIn April 2023, Warner Bros. officially confirmed that a new Harry Potter adaptation is coming. Now, it's closer than ever.The upcoming HBO series has officially set a release window for the television series for early 2027, according to Deadline. The announcement came on Jan. 30 from the Chairman and CEO of HBO and HBO Max Content, Casey Bloys."We’ve been saying 2027," Bloys told the outlet. "I would say, to narrow it down to some extent, early 2027. And now you’re going to ask, does that mean January, February, March, April, that we’re not ready to say. I’ll say early 2027."The series officially started filming in the summer of 2025, and...Voir l'article complet sur CBR30/01/2026par Monica ComanCBR“It’s quite strange”: Rupert Grint Reacts to His Harry Potter Replacement at HBORupert Grint is opening up about his reaction to being replaced in HBO’s upcoming Harry Potter reboot, and he admits the moment feels surprisingly surreal.The actor, who originated Ron Weasley in the blockbuster film franchise, has been watching the new series take shape as HBO assembles a young cast for its book-faithful adaptation.Speaking with the BBC about the recasting, Grint acknowledged that it is unusual to see another performer step into a role he grew up with, but he is genuinely curious to see how the new version unfolds.It’s quite strange to have the cycle happening again … I’m really intrigued what it’s going to be like.Voir l'article complet sur FandomWire24/11/2025par Zaina AsifFandomWireNew 'Harry Potter' Photos Show Off Costume Redesign & 'Sherlock' Star's Key RoleThe upcoming Harry Potter reboot from HBO has been filming for several months now, and fans have once again been treated to a new look at the big-budget production. While the television series has had its fair share of controversies, one of which is never-ending with J.K. Rowling's continued involvement, there are still plenty of people who have remained open-minded about the remake. It will certainly not please everyone, but it seems HBO's Harry Potter is making small adjustments to differentiate itself from the films while remaining faithful to the source material.New images from the set of HBO's Harry Potter series have surfaced online, featuring Dominic McLaughlin as Harry Potter,...Voir l'article complet sur MovieWeb12/11/2025par Marcos MelendezMovieWebHarry Potter Set Photos Reveal First Look At Hogwarts, As Actor Playing [Spoiler] Is RevealedAs we first reported on SFFGazette.com, several sets have been constructed for the upcoming Harry Potter TV series in Hertfordshire, England. It looks like these will all be different parts of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, with the castle itself likely to be a CG creation.Along with various parts of the castle grounds, we have Madam Sprout's Herbology Greenhouse, a garden leading to the Quidditch Pitch, and a building that looks an awful lot like Hagrid's Hut.Fans have wondered how HBO's Harry Potter would differ from the movies, and these sets suggest Hogwarts will have a much different feel. Hagrid's home, in particular, looks much different...Voir l'article complet sur ComicBookMovie.com10/10/2025ComicBookMovie.comHBO’s Harry Potter series conjures its first look at John Lithgow as Professor DumbledoreHBO‘s series reimagining of the Wizarding World of Harry Potter is in full swing, and today brings a first look at John Lithgow’s Professor Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore, the Headmaster of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.In the images posted by A Shot II on Facebook, John Lithgow’s Dumbledore walks along a water-tinged beachfront, his tattered dark blue robes levitating just above the sand, his long, white beard gently blowing in the breeze. On Lithgow’s face sits a fragile pair of spectacles while sizable rings adorn the pinkie and ring finger of his right hand. Oddly, Lithgow has something of a pained look on his wisened face.Voir l'article complet sur JoBlo.com08/10/2025par Steve SeighJoBlo.comNew Look at HBO's 'Harry Potter' Reboot Unveils Iconic Vehicle Fans Will Instantly RecognizeHBO's Harry Potteris currently in production, and fans have already been treated to candid looks at the main cast of the TV reboot. However, one of the most iconic parts of the films has surfaced in new images, and it is as recognizable as any character in the franchise.As Harry Potter continues filming in the United Kingdom, a sneak peek at the practical prop for the Hogwarts Express was spotted on its way to production. The iconic mode of transportation looks identical to what it did in the original film series.
